glosses: smoked (of food, preserved by treatment with smoke)
Of food, treated with smoke, often for flavor or as a method of preservation.

examples.text: 'A pair of smoked spectacles will do it,' he said positively. 'Look at him now; he looks like an angelic office boy. Put him on a pair of smoked spectacles, and children will scream at the sight of him.'
"You'll need smoked glasses to protect your eyes," Paul warned him.
